question: In which dialdehyde are two formyl groups attached to adjacent carbon centres on a benzene ring and form fluorescent conjugation products with primary amines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phthalaldehyde**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Phthalaldehyde**:-

 
 
• **It is the dialdehyde referred to in the question, which has two formyl groups attached to adjacent carbon centers on a benzene ring.**
